milestones.title: Week 1 — Architecture, Local Dev Env & API Contract
Week 2 — Core API (stops, photos, bikes, map)
Week 3 — Frontend PWA (map view, add-stop, offline queue)
Week 4 — Bikes UI, write-PIN, polish, real-device testing, deploy cutover

stories.title: Session 0 — architecture scaffolding (CLAUDE.md, agent roster, skills, architecture diagram, progress.json skeleton)
Local dev environment (docker-compose: FastAPI + Postgres + MinIO, Dockerfile, backend project skeleton)
Cloud service setup — Neon project, Cloudflare R2 bucket, Microsoft Graph app registration + OneDrive OAuth consent, Azure Container Apps environment, budget alert
stories.note: Touches OneDrive/.env/deployment config — devops agent only, needs explicit human approval per CLAUDE.md off-limits list.

stories.title: Seed the one trip record directly in Postgres (one-time script, no admin UI)
API contract definition (Session 1) — Pydantic models, status codes, error envelope, offline-queue idempotency
GET /trips/{slug} — trip metadata + this trip's bikes
Stop CRUD — GET/POST /trips/{slug}/stops
Photo upload + OneDrive sync — multipart upload to S3-compatible storage, background Graph sync job
Bike management — POST/PATCH /trips/{slug}/bikes
Map GeoJSON endpoint — GET /trips/{slug}/map
First-open display-name prompt (localStorage identity-by-label)
Trip home — Leaflet map with stop pins + auto-generated trail + chronological timeline feed
Add-stop flow — camera capture, GPS auto-fill with manual map-tap fallback, notes
Stop detail — photo gallery (thumbnail grid → enlarge), notes, timestamp on pin click
Offline queue — service worker + IndexedDB, resumable multipart upload, client-side photo resize/compress + HEIC→JPEG
Bikes page — this trip's 3 motorcycles, make/model/specs
Optional write-PIN on top of the rider link
Offline indicator — queued/pending sync UI
Real-device testing day with friends (airplane-mode capture, concurrent uploads, GPS-denied path)
Azure Container Apps production cutover
stories.note: Deployment config — devops agent only, needs explicit human approval per CLAUDE.md off-limits list.
